description: Canonical lifecycle event interoperability corpus for HarpocratesRegistry. Publishes expected Soroban event topics, typed ScVal payloads, and RFC-4506 XDR wire vectors across existing transitions, plus fail-closed negative cases.

cases.description: Register an active Tier 1 credential Merkle root.
Approve a Tier 3 institutional issuer.
Tier 1 Silent Witness registration emits ProofRegistered.
Tier 1 registration records anonymous ProofHistoryEvent (actor omitted).
Tier 1 registration stamps MetadataEnvelopeBound V1.
Tier 2 Consistent Source registration emits ProofRegistered.
Tier 2 registration records ProofHistoryEvent with source actor.
Tier 3 Public Seal registration emits ProofRegistered.
Administrative verification appends ProofHistoryEvent (Verified = 2).
Upgrading metadata envelope from V1 to V2 emits MetadataEnvelopeUpgraded.
Metadata hash correction appends ProofHistoryEvent (Corrected = 5).
Anchoring Stellar + claimed + RFC3161 timestamp claim emits TimestampClaimAnchored.
Derivative evidence registration emits LineageRegistered with opaque parent commitments.
Opening a dispute emits DisputeOpened with commitment hashes and deadline.
Source response to an open dispute emits DisputeResponded.
Admin resolution of a responded dispute emits DisputeResolved.
Admin dismissal of an open dispute emits DisputeDismissed.
Superseding a disputed proof with a replacement proof emits DisputeSuperseded.
Explicit proof expiration emits ProofHistoryEvent (Expired = 4).
Revoking a proof emits ProofRevoked with STATUS_REVOKED (2).
Revoking a proof appends ProofHistoryEvent (Revoked = 3).
Tier 2 Merkle batch root registration emits SourceBatchRootRegistered.
Attribute schema registration emits SchemaAdded.
Deprecating an active schema emits SchemaDeprecated.
Reactivating a deprecated schema emits SchemaReactivated.
Updating the active revocation tree root emits RevocationRootSet.
Revoking a Tier 1 credential root emits CredentialRootRevoked.
Revoking a Tier 3 institutional issuer emits IssuerRevoked.
Truncated ScVal topic vector XDR fails closed.
Trailing unconsumed bytes after ScVal payload fail closed.
Non-zero RFC-4506 4-byte padding in variable-length XDR bytes fails closed.
Unrecognized lifecycle event topic prefix fails closed.
ProofRegistered topic vector missing trailing proof_id fails closed.
ProofRegistered topic carrying u32 instead of 32-byte proof_id fails closed.
ProofRegistered payload omitting required tier field fails closed.
ScMap with out-of-order or duplicate symbol keys fails closed.
